propositions: Production Python complexity debt (53+ C901 findings at threshold 15 under src/rebar) cannot be gated with raw Ruff exit code because 53 known findings would block every change; a shrink-only wrapper baseline records exact current ceilings and rejects only new or increased debt.

The wrapper script accepts Ruff return codes 0 and 1 as normal diagnostic-bearing operation (both states are valid JSON export modes), treats return code 2+ as scanner failure, and compares current diagnostics to committed baseline ceilings to compute active/new/increased/stale counters with guarded --update-stale maintenance that refuses regressions.

Baseline JSON schema enforces a single source-of-truth document with schema_version 1, strictly sorted ceilings mapping repository-relative-POSIX path::qualified-AST-symbol keys to integer scores >15, rejects duplicate keys/members/unknown fields/invalid UTF-8, and is persisted atomically through fsutil.atomic_write to prevent partial writes.

Symbol identity is derived from Python AST FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef nodes with dot-joined class/function ancestry (e.g., src/rebar/example.py::Service.run), rejecting lambdas, rejecting overload-only declarations, and failing on duplicate qualified-key collisions rather than line-number disambiguation.

The wrapper exits zero on --check when all current findings match their baselines (active=N new=0 increased=0) and stale entries are permitted; --update-stale atomically lowers and removes stale ceilings while refusing to write on new/increased debt, scanner error, or injected atomic-write failure, leaving target bytes unchanged on failure.
